description: Brand profile for Serenity Blooms, a small local cut-flower business. Use this profile to guide visual and stylistic choices for marketing emails while preserving a warm, handcrafted, floral feel.

color_guidance.primary_direction: Favor soft blush/pink backgrounds, cream and white surfaces, sage green accents, and dark charcoal or warm-gray text.
avoid: pink body text on pink backgrounds
color_guidance.contrast_rule: Use dark charcoal or sage-dark text on light backgrounds. Use white or cream text on dark sage buttons.

typography_guidance.headings: Use elegant serif typography for prominent headings when supported.
typography_guidance.body: Use a clean sans-serif stack for readability.
avoid: decorative script fonts for body copy
using more than two font families in one email

button_options.style_guidance: Buttons should feel simple, polished, and easy to read rather than flashy.

avoid: heavy graphic overlays that obscure flowers
visual treatments that make the business feel mass-market

logo_guidance.asset_source: Use the primary Serenity Blooms logo returned by the logo retrieval tool.
logo_guidance.guidance: Keep the logo clearly visible with generous surrounding space. Do not invent alternate logo artwork.

avoid: claims that are not supported by the campaign or product information

email_design_rules.overall: Favor a light, airy, floral presentation with restrained use of blush pink and sage green.
email_design_rules.text_rule: Body copy should remain dark and highly readable; do not use pink as the main text color.
email_design_rules.layout_rule: Use approved email-safe blocks and allow the composition agent to choose block order within compatibility rules.
email_design_rules.asset_rule: Use only images, logos, and blocks returned by storehouse tools. Do not invent asset URLs or filenames.
